_note: Single source of truth for outreach copy. `node tools/pipeline.mjs msg <id>` fills these from the prospect record. outreach/templates.md is the prose guidance; this file is what actually gets sent. Edit here.

_slots.{{name}}: contact first name, or the company if unknown
_slots.{{observation}}: what a human SAW during verification - never generated
_slots.{{product}}: the specific dish, bottle, bag, treatment or class to shoot
_slots.{{consequence}}: why that observation costs them something specific

cold-email.subject: your {{product}} photos
cold-email.body:
{{name}} -

{{observation}}

That's fixable, and it's the one I'd fix first - {{consequence}}.

I'm a chef. I shoot food and product commercially now. If it's useful I'll put together a one-page plan for {{product}}: camera, lighting, composition, background, and the hook the frame should carry. Free, no call needed, and you can hand it to whoever shoots for you.

Want it?

Larry
Apex Content Studio
rules: Under 120 words
No link
No price
No attachment
One question only
No link in a first DM, ever
Under 60 words
Lower case is fine here, this is not email

linkedin.body:
{{name}} - we haven't met. I'm a chef in Las Vegas who now shoots commercial food and product content.

{{observation}}

Not pitching a retainer at you on a first message. If it's useful I'll put together a one-page creative plan for {{product}} - free, and yours to use with anyone.

Worth sending over?
rules: Slightly more formal than DM
Connection note version: first 2 lines only, 300 char limit
No link

followup-1.subject: re: {{subject}}
followup-1.body:
Made this anyway - the plan for {{product}}.

{{plan}}

Use it with anyone. If you'd rather I just shot it, that's a conversation. If not, no reply needed.

Larry
rules: Send whether or not they replied. This is the email that converts.
{{plan}} is 3-5 lines: camera position, light direction and quality, composition, background, and the one hook the frame carries.
For a prospect scoring 9-10, shoot one actual frame instead of writing the plan. Nothing outsells the work.

followup-2.subject: re: {{subject}}
followup-2.body:
{{name}} - one more thought and then I'll leave it.

{{tip}}

Costs nothing and it's the difference on most {{product}} shots. If the photography ever moves up the list, I'm here.

Larry
rules: {{tip}} must be genuinely useful and specific to their product. Give it away with no strings.
This is the last message that offers anything.

breakup.subject: re: {{subject}}
breakup.body:
Going to stop bothering you, {{name}}.

The plan I sent is yours either way. If it ever moves up the list, I'm easy to find.

Larry
rules: Then genuinely stop.
90 days before this company is touched again.
A third chase converts nobody and costs the sending domain.

warm-direct.subject: quick one
warm-direct.body:
{{name}} - I've started doing commercial content properly, on my own now. Product and food photography, short video, the assets brands actually need for menus, socials and paid.

You know what my standards are in a kitchen. Same thing, pointed at a camera.

Two things I'd value:

1. If {{company}} needs product or menu photography, I'd rather do your first one than a stranger's.
2. If not - who's the one person you'd introduce me to?

Either answer is useful. No pitch attached.

Larry
rules: For people who already know Larry
No observation needed - the relationship is the qualification

warm-referral.subject: one intro
warm-referral.body:
{{name}} - not selling you anything. I'm building the content side out properly and I'm after one introduction, not ten.

Who do you know running a food brand, restaurant or bottled product whose photography doesn't match how good the actual product is?

That's the whole ask. Happy to send you the work first if it's easier to vouch for.

Larry
rules: Ask for ONE intro. A list gets deferred, then forgotten.
